note: What the library holds. scripts/build_music_library.py generates each track from its prompt and records it in catalog.json. Every prompt is instrumental only.

tracks.prompt: Calm, warm instrumental background music for a product video. Soft felt piano, gentle warm pads, a light steady pulse at about 80 BPM. Even dynamics with no big build, no drops, no vocals, no lyrics. Seamless and loop-friendly.

Upbeat, bright instrumental background music for a social media video. Clean electric guitar plucks, claps, light drums and bass at about 110 BPM. Positive and friendly, even energy throughout, no vocals, no lyrics. Seamless and loop-friendly.

Modern technology instrumental background music for a software product demo. Crisp electronic arpeggios, soft synth bass, tight minimal beat at about 100 BPM. Focused and clean, even energy, no vocals, no lyrics. Seamless and loop-friendly.

Cinematic instrumental background music for a brand story. Warm strings, soft piano, gentle percussion, a sense of quiet ambition at about 90 BPM. Steady intensity rather than one big climax, no vocals, no lyrics. Seamless and loop-friendly.

Warm acoustic instrumental background music for a friendly small-business video. Fingerpicked acoustic guitar, light shaker, soft bass at about 95 BPM. Cozy and human, even dynamics, no vocals, no lyrics. Seamless and loop-friendly.

Inspiring, uplifting instrumental background music for a launch announcement. Piano chords, bright synth layers, steady kick and claps at about 115 BPM. Hopeful and confident, consistent energy, no vocals, no lyrics. Seamless and loop-friendly.

Minimal ambient instrumental background music for an explainer video. Airy pads, soft glassy textures, very light rhythmic ticks at about 85 BPM. Unobtrusive under a voice-over, no vocals, no lyrics. Seamless and loop-friendly.

Energetic, driving instrumental background music for a fast-paced promo. Punchy drums, distorted synth bass, bright stabs at about 125 BPM. Powerful and dynamic but even, no vocals, no lyrics. Seamless and loop-friendly.
